name: review-check-receipt-pinning
title: sd-review pins a failed sd-check receipt to the head, so worktree-local repairs never clear
description: The sd-review coordinator stores its typed deterministic sd-check result and only recomputes it when the stored value is null, so a failed check is cached and replayed for the same attempt ID. Worktree-local, gitignored failures such as knowledge.obsidian-kb can never clear, because their documented remediation produces no commit and therefore no new head. Define and implement an invalidation rule that lets a repaired non-passing check re-evaluate without weakening the gate or reusing --attempt as the key.
creator: sdelmas
